per_candidate.id: s2:On the Dark Matter Profile Mass Dependence
s2:Rotation curves of LSBGs and dwarf galaxies in a nearly Newtonian solution
s2:Further evidence for a population of dark-matter-deficient dwarf galaxies

rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate the comparison of mass profiles and rotation curves of galaxies with slowly-rising rotation curves to those in standard dark matter halos, nor do they address the implications for dark matter models like Warm Dark Matter versus Cold Dark Matter.
